items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states that younger clients (Gen Z, ages 13-28) learn about finances primarily through social media and family, which is why Schwab meets them in those channels.
items.quote: We know they learn about finances primarily through social media and family.
items.scope: younger (Gen Z) retail clients at Schwab

items.text: Schwab CEO Rick Wurster states that younger investors' top online resource is YouTube, and Schwab is the number one financial services firm on YouTube by followers.
items.quote: Their top online resource is YouTube, and we're the number one financial services firm on YouTube by followers.

items.text: The CFPB reports that younger Americans are far more likely to embrace social media, podcasts and generative AI to meet their financial information needs, and that 32% of Americans turn to a financial advisor (such as a CFP professional).
items.quote: Younger Americans are far more likely to embrace social media, podcasts and generative AI to meet their financial information needs.

items.text: A Wealthtender survey reports the channels consumers (all ages, not broken out by age) plan to use to find a financial advisor, including referrals from friends or family (62%), search engines (49.8%), financial institution (49%), referrals from professionals (49.2%), online advisor directories (31.8%), AI search tools (25.4%), and social media (22.2%).

cells.differs_because: No passage states the specific channels and sources that clients under 40 use to find and research a financial advisor. The Schwab and CFPB passages describe channels younger clients use to learn about finances or meet financial information needs (a different purpose than finding/researching an advisor), while the Wealthtender passage describes channels used to find an advisor but for all consumers, not clients under 40.
cells.reason: The passages provide related but not exactly matching evidence: younger clients' channels for financial information (Schwab, CFPB) and all-consumer channels for finding an advisor (Wealthtender), so I labeled the cell different_quantity.
